post.content:
This segment is part two in a series exploring what is Purple Lemon Photography.

Wedding + Engagement Photography

When Purple Lemon Photography was begun, it was out of a love for wedding photography that had developed as I worked as an associate for a wedding photography company in college. I discovered that I love wedding photography. It appeals to my love for creating and organizing events, celebrations, and relationships. The varied, long, fast-paced days are thrilling for me, and gives me much creative inspiration. I love working with the families and blessing the couple in every way I can.

Photographing engagements gives me time to build relationships with the couples I’ll be spending the day with on their wedding day, and find ways to visually represent their story.

Portraits

Alongside weddings and engagements, I also photograph many babies, children, and families. I love using the skills I’ve developed as a parent of children with sensory integration issues to engage children in fun and meaningful ways with their own families during their photography session.
